scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB,ADMIN -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @aigc/api" "npm run dev -w @aigc/web" "npm run dev -w admin-console"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aigc/api && npm run build -w @aigc/web && npm run build -w admin-console
scripts.check: npm run check -w @aigc/api && npm run build -w @aigc/api && npm run build -w @aigc/web && npm run test:sites -w @aigc/web && npm run build -w admin-console && npm run test:sites -w admin-console
